name: health-and-fitness
description: Personal-heavy: user wants to get healthier this summer. Work goals should still appear but personal goals lead.
initial_prompt: I want to get back into shape this summer. I used to be pretty active — lifted three times a week, ran on weekends — but the last year of crunch at work killed all of that. I also want to use this energy to be better at my actual job, not just abandon work for the gym.
scripted_user_replies: I work as a staff engineer at a mid-size SaaS company. Things have calmed down — I'm not in crunch anymore — but I'm coasting. I'd like to ship something meaningful again. On the health side, lifting is what I miss most. Running I can take or leave.
Two weeks. My wife would be the natural accountability person, plus I have an old lifting partner I've fallen out of touch with — re-engaging him would actually be part of this.
